import itertools, json
def load(k): return G[k]
D=[(load(f'Demo pair {i} input'),load(f'Demo pair {i} output')) for i in (1,2,3)]
SP=[(9,4),(8,1),(3,5)]; BG=[4,1,5]

def mst_out(g,sp,bg,order='rowcol',orient='hv'):
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]==sp]
    if order=='rowcol': pts=sorted(pts)
    elif order=='colrow': pts=sorted(pts,key=lambda p:(p[1],p[0]))
    # Prim MST starting from pts[0], tie-break by index
    import heapq
    n=len(pts); inT=[False]*n; par=[None]*n
    best=[(abs(pts[i][0]-pts[0][0])+abs(pts[i][1]-pts[0][1]), i, 0) for i in range(n)]
    # simple O(n^2) prim with deterministic tie-break (dist, index)
    inT[0]=True; edges=[]
    for _ in range(n-1):
        cand=[(abs(pts[i][0]-pts[j][0])+abs(pts[i][1]-pts[j][1]), max(i,j), min(i,j), i, j)
              for i in range(n) if inT[i] for j in range(n) if not inT[j]]
        d,_,_,i,j=min(cand)
        inT[j]=True; edges.append((i,j,d))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i,j,d in edges:
        r1,c1=pts[i]; r2,c2=pts[j]
        # L path: vertical first or horizontal first, deterministic
        cells=[]
        if orient=='hv':
            cells+= [(r,c1) for r in (range(r1,r2) if r2>r1 else range(r1,r2,-1))]
            cells+= [(r2,c) for c in (range(c1,c2) if c2>c1 else range(c1,c2,-1))]
        else:
            cells+= [(r1,c) for c in (range(c1,c2) if c2>c1 else range(c1,c2,-1))]
            cells+= [(r,r2) for r in (range(r1,r2) if r2>r1 else range(r1,r2,-1))]
        for r,c in cells:

import os,re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
for k in sorted(G):
    if k not in globals(): pass
print('test same as Tcur:', G['Test input']==Tcur)
for i in (1,2,3):
    print(f'demo{i} same:', G[f'Demo pair {i} input']==D[i-1][0], G[f'Demo pair {i} output']==D[i-1][1])
def perim(g,sp,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==sp]
    r0,r1=min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0,c1=min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)
    return [[2 if (g[r][c]==bg and ((r in (r0,r1) and c0<=c<=c1) or (c in (c0,c1) and r0<=r<=r1))) else g[r][c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
for i in (1,2,3):
    gi,go=D[i-1]
    sp=min({x for r in gi for x in r}, key=lambda col: sum(r.count(col) for r in gi))
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    spc=cnt.most_common()[-1][0]; bgc=cnt.most_common()[0][0]
    print('demo',i,'colors',cnt.most_common(),'-> perim ok:', perim(gi,spc,bgc)==go)

def perim(g, sp, bg):
